lessons.trigger_condition: The adaptive controller could reorder eight categories and eighteen shortcuts, but the real target screens only received normal navigation. Repeated verified deficits also produced surface-level protected PR candidates rather than a concrete needed-feature selection.
lessons.prevention_rule: Score all eighteen allowlisted features from verified surface deficits plus non-directional release/event/trading activity, rank only existing screen targets, annotate the real target modules without DOM reordering, restore all annotations when the user disables adaptation, and translate repeated verified surface gaps into specific protected-PR-only needed-feature candidates.
validation_required: watched changes are exactly tablet_autonomous_evolution_v400.py, tablet_autonomy_dashboard_v400.css and tablet_autonomy_dashboard_v400.js
all eighteen feature priorities are finite bounded scores and every category order remains an exact permutation of its allowlist
screen module rankings contain exactly the eighteen allowlisted feature keys and exact existing target ids
browser applies focus annotations only to existing target ids and never reorders the main document body
user disable or fetch failure restores category order, feature order and all module focus annotations
repeated verified deficits select a specific needed feature recipe but runtime source generation and git writes remain forbidden
market release and event activity remains non-directional and cannot promote invented facts
repository integrity, tablet runtime delivery, alignment, grading vision, deep and exhaustive regression checks pass
physical tablet runtime remains unverified until device-side evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V399 sync records a bounded declarative full-screen prioritization layer. It may rank existing categories, shortcuts and target modules and select protected-PR feature recipes, but it cannot synthesize or execute new source code at runtime, reorder arbitrary DOM, write Git/main, bypass verification, infer market direction, or fabricate price, grade, stock, release or event facts.
